newsitem.title: UK: Siemens eyes Rolls power unit-paper.
newsitem.headline: Siemens eyes Rolls power unit-paper.

text.p: Siemens AG, the German engineering and technology group, is looking at the possible purchase of Rolls Royce's Parsons turbine unit as part of a wider deal which could lead to it buying other power divisions in the UK company, said a report in the Sunday Times.
A deal was under discussion between both parties, with industry insiders believing Siemens could also take control of Rolls' switchgear company and transformer unit, Peebles, the paper said.
But Parsons is also cited as a possible target of U.S. giant General Electric.
If the division is sold by the UK engine-maker Rolls it could lead to job cuts, said the report.

The report quoted Jurgen Gehrels, Siemens UK chief executive, stating "We are always looking at business opportunities especially those where we can strengthen the position of our individual businesses...I don't know yet whether Parsons is such a business, but we are looking at it." --London newsroom +44 171 5427717
